name: Free Music Player & Song Search – TuneBash
description: Free music player in a Chrome side panel. Search songs, build a queue, save favorites, and keep listening while you work.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' https: data:; media-src 'self' https: blob:; frame-src https://tunebash.com https://www.tunebash.com; connect-src 'self' https://tunebash.com https://www.tunebash.com https://itunes.apple.com; object-src 'none'
